hybrid_rrf.question: How can a student book a library study room at RMIT?
hybrid_rrf.answer:
To book a library study room at RMIT, a student should follow these steps:

1. **Access the Library Website**: Go to the RMIT library website at [https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn) and select “Book a study room” [Source, n.d.](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn/student-support/book-a-study-room).

2. **Sign In**: Choose the campus and sign in using their RMIT ID number as the username and their RMIT password [Source, 2025](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/documents/pdfs/library/en/study-room-booking-instruction-2025.pdf).

3. **Select Room and Time**: Choose a room and the desired time for the booking.

4. **Confirm Booking**: Press “Request” and then check availability to confirm the booking [Source, n.d.](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn/student-support/book-a-study-room).

Students can book up to 2 weeks in advance, with a maximum of 1 hour per slot and a limit of 2 bookings per person [Source, n.d.](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn/student-support/book-a-study-room).

References:
- [Source, n.d.](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn/student-support/book-a-study-room)
- [Source, 2025](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/documents/pdfs/library/en/study-room-booking-instruction-2025.pdf)

dense_only.question: How can a student book a library study room at RMIT?
dense_only.answer:
A student can book a library study room at RMIT by following these steps:

1. Access the Library Website: Go to [the library website](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn).
2. Sign in: Choose your campus and log in using your RMIT ID number as the username and your RMIT password.
3. Check Availability: Select a room and check its availability.
4. Confirm Booking: Once a room is selected, confirm your booking.

Additionally, students must adhere to the booking policy, which includes booking up to 2 weeks in advance, a maximum of 1 hour per slot, and a maximum of 2 bookings per person. Students must also check in at the library front desk within 15 minutes prior to their scheduled booking to avoid cancellation [Source, Year](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/libraryvn/student-support/book-a-study-room) [Source, 2025](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/documents/pdfs/library/en/study-room-booking-instruction-2025.pdf).
